name: smwmusic-the-lawnmower-man-main-theme
title: The Lawnmower Man - Main Theme
description:
The song most famously known from "A2MT - B-Side." Now you can use this banger in your hacks without the need for MSU-1!

This was made using spc2mml. Is most fitting for castles or final stages. Shoutout to Blind Devil for help with the weird SFX.
